sections.title: About
sections.content: Join a foundation guide for an intimate walkthrough of works currently on view. The tour highlights recent acquisitions and the conversations they open across generations of artists in the collection.

sections.title: Ticket Infos and Prices
sections.content: General admission: $15. Members and students: $10. Tickets can be reserved online in advance or purchased at the door subject to availability. Doors open thirty minutes before the tour begins.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.content: The venue is wheelchair accessible with step-free entry and accessible restrooms. Assistive listening devices are available on request. For specific accommodations, please contact the gallery ahead of your visit.
